title: rehdera trinervis
intro: Rehdera trinervis, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry or three-veined rehdera, is a plant species belonging to the family Polygonaceae. The Himalayan raspberry is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of rehdera trinervis are attributed to its antidiabetic, antihypertensive, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can aid in managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of rehdera trinervis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
